tools.name: get_page_info
tools.description: Returns metadata and available structured sections for the current page. This tool never changes the page or server state.

tools.name: list_page_sections
tools.description: Lists the structured sections available to read on the current page, including their paths and approximate text sizes.

tools.name: read_page_content
tools.description: Reads structured content from the current page without changing it. Optionally select a section path and use the returned nextCursor to continue long content.

section.description: Optional section path from list_page_sections. Omit to read all structured page content.

cursor.description: Character cursor returned by a previous call. Defaults to 0.

maxCharacters.description: Maximum characters to return, from 200 to 1500.

tools.name: search_page_content
tools.description: Searches the structured content embedded in the current page and returns matching paths and concise snippets. This tool does not navigate or submit anything.

query.description: Text to find in the current page content.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return. Defaults to 5.
